system.description:
A dhampir-exclusive Merit. Gypsy legend holds that dhampirs can always recognize a vampire for what she is; a dhampir's first such recognition, and its implications, can be a shock to her.

2-Trait Merit: You automatically recognize a vampire regardless of Merits such as Blush of Health, thaumaturgical rituals, makeup or other attempts at concealment. Mask of a Thousand Faces fools your senses about the image projected, but you still know the individual is a vampire, and you can sense (though not pinpoint) vampires hidden by Obfuscate nearby. Particularly ancient or clever vampires' powers may still fool you, at the Storyteller's discretion.

5-Trait Merit: You automatically pierce any attempt at disguise, including the most formidable Obfuscate powers of the Ancients — you always recognize a vampire for what she is no matter what she does to hide it.
